info.name: Workday Extend Workday Custom Objects App Configurations Custom Object Instances API
Workday Extend Retrieve custom object data for a worker

params.name: workerId
params.description: The unique Workday identifier of the worker

params.name: customObjectName
params.description: The name of the custom object type

items.docs: Returns the custom object instance data attached to the specified worker. Supports both single-instance and multi-instance custom objects. For multi-instance objects, returns a collection of instances.

info.name: Workday Extend Create or update custom object data for a worker

params.name: workerId
params.description: The unique Workday identifier of the worker

params.name: customObjectName
params.description: The name of the custom object type

items.docs: Creates or updates the custom object instance data attached to the specified worker. If the custom object does not exist for the worker, it is created. Otherwise, the existing data is updated with the provided values.

info.name: Workday Extend Delete custom object data for a worker

params.name: workerId
params.description: The unique Workday identifier of the worker

params.name: customObjectName
params.description: The name of the custom object type

items.docs: Deletes the custom object instance data attached to the specified worker.

params.name: customObjectName
